images.name: CARE-ASE
main_modules_visible: explicit LGE, T2 and C0 inputs with modality-availability semantics
one stock-compatible full-volume encoder and bottleneck
shared mature low/mid-resolution decoding path
separate high-resolution anatomy-preserving path
LGE-dominant scar proposal/localization and scar reconstruction path
T2-dominant pure-edema reconstruction path with bounded auxiliary support
conditional final pathology/anatomy class competition and deployment safeguards
images.key_dataflow: Observed sequences enter one mature full-volume backbone. Shared low/mid-resolution decoding retains anatomical capability, while the high-resolution stage assigns asymmetric authority: LGE drives scar localization/reconstruction and T2 drives pure-edema reconstruction. These outputs join the anatomy logits only at the conditional final competition rather than through an external post-hoc correction network.
missing_modality_and_no_t2_rules: missingness is represented explicitly rather than interpreted as an ordinary observed image
when T2 is absent, edema-owned computation is excluded for that row
class 4 is excluded from the final no-T2 competition, yielding background/anatomy/scar five-class semantics
explicitly_absent_from_figure: a second complete U-Net or second full backbone
images.critic_judgment: The Planner description is materially faithful. The absence claims are interpreted only as absence from this diagram, not proof that arbitrary hidden implementation code could not exist.

images.name: SRR-v3
main_modules_visible: partially observed multi-sequence inputs and availability-aware routing
nnU-Net anchor/context interface with anatomy, probability, uncertainty and component evidence
modality-specific shared/private/interaction semantic representation retrieval
positive, negative and safe-negative prototype or memory evidence
separate anatomy-guided scar and edema proposal paths
pathology-specific soft-ROI scar and edema refiners
bounded baseline-preserving residual correction
Cine anatomy, registration and temporal retrieval/aggregation lane
images.key_dataflow: The available modalities first determine which semantic representation slots may be retrieved. Retrieved evidence and anchor-derived anatomy/probability/uncertainty/component context form distinct scar and edema proposals. Those proposals define pathology-specific soft regions of interest, after which separate refiners produce bounded deltas that are arbitrated around the mature anchor. The Cine lane aligns multi-frame anatomy/features before temporal aggregation.
missing_modality_and_no_t2_rules: private and interaction slots involving unavailable modalities are masked
no-T2 cases are not used as ordinary edema-negative supervision
edema correction fails closed when reliable T2 evidence is unavailable
explicitly_absent_from_figure: unrestricted replacement of the mature full decoder by one generic pathology head
a single shared scar/edema proposal-refiner head
images.critic_judgment: The Planner correctly separates evidence selection from lesion formation and final-output authority. This distinction is sufficient for later downgrade detection: a dictionary or memory that exists but does not influence proposal, refiner and bounded final logits is not faithful SRR-v3.

images.name: MoSAIC
main_modules_visible: separate Multi-sequence MyoPS and CineMyoPS workflows
heterogeneous multi-sequence evidence
CoarseNet-style coarse localization
anatomy-conditioned multi-scale fusion
independent fine pathology experts or FinePathNet paths
anatomy/pathology output merging
ED-anchored cine anatomy and motion inference
images.key_dataflow: The MyoPS side uses heterogeneous sequences for coarse localization, anatomy-conditioned fusion and independent fine pathology inference before output merging. The Cine side uses an end-diastolic reference together with anatomy and motion evidence to infer across frames. This is a coarse-to-fine expert system rather than an anchor-bounded retrieval-and-correction system.
missing_modality_and_no_t2_rules: the figure indicates heterogeneous-evidence handling but does not expose a row-wise no-T2 five-class exclusion contract
no explicit safe-negative retrieval memory or availability-slot masking rule is displayed
explicitly_absent_from_figure: nnU-Net anchor plus bounded residual correction
images.critic_judgment: The Planner correctly treats MoSAIC as a coarse-to-fine benchmark and mechanism comparison, not as a substitute for the CARE-ASE contract.

cross_architecture_judgment: CARE-ASE assigns direct asymmetric reconstruction responsibility inside one mature full-volume backbone.
SRR-v3 selects evidence and forms proposals/refinements around a strong anchor, with every claimed module required to reach bounded final logits.
MoSAIC uses coarse-to-fine independent experts and a separate ED-anchored cine workflow without SRR retrieval or anchor-bounded arbitration.

The strongest explicit row-wise no-T2 execution and five-class authority rule is visible in CARE-ASE; SRR-v3 expresses safety through availability/reliable-label/fail-closed correction; MoSAIC does not display the same contract.
